turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Patil, I am Rohan from the digital security cell in Pune. We have noticed some suspicious login attempts on your mobile banking app today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hello? Yes, but I have not used my phone for banking since morning. What is the problem?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is exactly the issue, sir. Someone is trying to bypass your security, and we need to lock your account immediately to prevent a loss.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my God, please tell me what to do. I have my pension money in that account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, I will help you. First, please download the AnyDesk app from the Play Store so I can secure your settings remotely.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: AnyDesk? I do not know this app. Is it really necessary for the bank?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it is a standard tool for our technical team to fix the glitch. Just tell me the nine digit code that appears on your screen.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, wait one minute. The code is 422 891 034.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, I am connected now. I can see the error, but to reverse the unauthorized transaction of one lakh rupees, I need you to verify your identity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh rupees? I did not send any money! Please stop it quickly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am trying, sir. Now a verification OTP has been sent to your phone, please read it out to me so I can credit the money back to you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The message says it is for a payment authorization, not a refund. Why is it saying that?
